column1: # One row per event a port can fire. The per-title hook configs
# (configs/hooks/<title>.mod-events.hooks.tsv) place the calls; every call is
# into host/staticr_scale_defaults.c, which is a no-op unless a listener is
# subscribed or STATICR_MOD_EVENTS_DEBUG is set. Argument order is fixed per
# event here, whatever the guest function's own parameter order.
# compat: the N64Recomp event name an existing .nrm mod subscribes to for the same
# point, when there is one. These are matched by name and position only (the event fires
# at the ENTRY of the named function), not by any upstream implementation. "-" = none.
# columns: id <TAB> event <TAB> a0 <TAB> a1 <TAB> compat <TAB> fires

column6: once, at the entry of the game's Main thread function
entry of Play_Init (a gameplay scene starts)
entry of Play_Main (once per gameplay frame)
entry of Play_Update (once per gameplay update)
entry of Play_Draw (once per drawn gameplay frame)
entry of Play_Destroy (a gameplay scene ends)
entry of Actor_Init (once per spawned actor)
entry of Actor_Draw (once per drawn actor per frame)
